contracts_enforced.S2_EXACT_MODEL_SCOPE_EVIDENCE: Canonical fitment on another published model with exact matching scope has verifiable source evidence for a distinct canonical section.
contracts_enforced.S3_EXISTING_MULTI_SECTION_CONTEXT: Existing verified record in model_part_fitment_section_contexts provides a distinct second section on a published model.
contracts_enforced.S4_SAME_MODEL_EXACT_POSITION_EVIDENCE: Within the same model, same variant_key, same configuration_key, and exact diagram_position, source evidence proves a distinct canonical section without conflict.

forbidden_practices_enforced: NO_MODEL_FAMILY_INFERENCE (MS 170 -> MS 180 or MS 260 -> MS 261 forbidden)
